acceptanceCriteria: The issue's minimal shape (helper defined in the spec file and in a shared_context/support file) is reproduced as fixtures against origin/main and its verdict recorded.

If already flagged: #1358 is closed with a comment citing V1-1866 and the fixture result. Otherwise the gap is fixed so the example is INELIGIBLE (vacuous) with the callee and its definition location, and the rewrite data = read_data; expect(...) plus yield/block_given?/&block helpers stay clean.
body: GitHub #1358 (filed after V1-1866 / #1163 delivered RB-BLOCK-NEVER-YIELDED) reports a real suite with 16 call sites across 4 spec files where a block holding every expectation is passed to a helper that never yields (minimal shape: def read_data; StringIO.new(build_csv); end; read_data do |data| expect(...) end), and says nothing distinguishes these examples. Reproduce the issue's minimal shape and the shared-context/support-file variant against current origin/main. If flagged, close #1358 citing V1-1866 with the fixture evidence; if not (e.g. the helper is a plain def in the spec file or the run-receipt projection path does not consult the static check), fix the gap.
